Directions: Based on the following, answer each question that follows.
Content: In a `text(two-phase)` study, participants were randomly assigned to either group `text(A)` or group `text(B)`. All participants were subjected to a series of irritating air puffs directed at the face. In the `text(first)` phase of the study, participants in group `text(A)` pressed a button that stopped the air puffs. Participants in group `text(B)` pressed a button that had no effect on the air puffs. In the `text(second)` phase of the study, both groups had buttons that, if pressed, would stop the air puffs.
